project.name: DendrOSM
project.description: Quality assurance map of OSM trees and tree stumps, by region.

tags.description: Trees shown on the map and checked for errors.
Tree stumps, drawn as an X sized by circumference and checked like trees.
Filter and info card. Flagged if it is a single word, starts lowercase or differs from genus; used to look up limits, leaf type and Wikidata ID in the wiki species list.

Flagged if it does not match species according to the wiki species list.

Trunk size on the map. Flagged above 43 m, above the species record, with a decimal comma or a non-numeric value.

Flagged above 115.92 m, above the species record, with a decimal comma or a non-numeric value; used to estimate a missing trunk size.
Crown size on the map. Flagged with a decimal comma or a non-numeric value.
